text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Nakayama Festa spoke to her former 
homeroom teacher. —Stay alive. Just watch 
me. Watch how I live. —Your hope isn't 
going to vanish.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Before the decisive battle, words are no 
longer needed between the two. Umamusume 
speak only through their legs.
